info.title: LUX Middle Tier API
info.description:
HTTP API exposed by the LUX middle tier (lux-middletier). The middle tier sits
between the LUX frontend and the MarkLogic backend: it relays requests to the
backend, rewrites entity URIs from the search host to the result host, and adds
HAL links to entity documents.

Most endpoints pass their parameters through to the backend. For full details
of backend parameters and response formats, see the
[backend API documentation](https://github.com/project-lux/lux-marklogic/blob/main/docs/lux-backend-api-usage.md).

All routes accept CORS preflight (`OPTIONS`) requests on any path, answered with
`200` and permissive `Access-Control-Allow-*` headers.

get.description:
Returns the Linked Art JSON document for a single entity. The entity URI is
built as `https://lux.collections.yale.edu/data/{scope}/{uuid}`. If no `profile`
is given, the response includes [HAL links](./hal-links.md) under `_links`
based on the entity type.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Entity identifier segment of the URI.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Backend profile name. When specified, the response is a filtered (smaller) document and HAL links are not added.

200.description: Linked Art document, with `_links` when no profile is specified.

404.description: No document exists for the URI. The body is JSON `null`.

get.description: Returns the LUX JSON search grammar translation of the given search string.

200.description: The search string translated to the LUX JSON search grammar, with `_scope` set to the requested scope.

get.summary: Translate a natural-language query to LUX JSON search grammar using AI
get.description:
Uses a generative AI model to translate a natural-language request into a LUX
JSON search query. Only available when the server is configured with Google
Cloud credentials otherwise every request returns `404`.

parameters.name: prevQuery
parameters.description: A previous LUX JSON search query to refine, allowing follow-up requests such as "only the ones from the 1960s".

200.description: Search options generated from the request. The first option returned is a keyword search; the rest are structured searches.

schema.description: A list of objects containing the translated query and the natural-language description.

items.description: One search option (`IAiDisambiguation` in the frontend).

natural.description: Plain-language description of the search, for showing to the user.

query.description: The search for this option, in the LUX JSON search grammar.

value.natural: Objects classified as paintings and produced by Andy Warhol

404.description: AI translation is not enabled on this server or a request to the endpoint has failed.

get.description: Experimental; not currently used by LUX in production.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Search term context, in the form `scope.term`.

get.summary: Redirect from a unit identifier to a LUX record
get.description:
Finds the LUX record with the given identifier and redirects to its view page.
If the identifier alone matches more than one record, the search is narrowed to
records held by the given unit.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Yale unit that holds the record.

302.description: A unique record was found. Redirects to its view page.

Location.description: URL of the record's view page, e.g. `https://lux.collections.yale.edu/view/object/{uuid}`.

400.description: Invalid scope or unit, or the identifier and unit don't resolve to a unique record.

404.description: No record matches the identifier and unit.

QueryRequired.name: q
QueryRequired.description: Search query in the LUX JSON search grammar, URL-encoded.

Sort.name: sort
Sort.description: Sort specification, passed through to the backend.

FilterResults.name: filterResults
FilterResults.description: Any value other than `false` is treated as `true`.

BackendJson.description: Response from the backend, with entity URIs rewritten to the result host. See the backend documentation for the format.

Error.description: Error from the middle tier or the backend.

_links.description: HAL links, present only when no `profile` is specified. Contains `self`, a `curies` array, and one entry per relation with `href` and `_estimate`. See docs/hal-links.md.

PartOf.description: A collection that the results page is part of. May itself be part of another collection.

OrderedItem.description: An entry in a results page. For facets, each entry is one facet value; for a related list, each entry is one relationship. `totalItems` counts the matching records and `first` links to the search that returns them.

value.description: The value this entry represents: a facet value (an entity URI, a string, or a number), or the URI of the related entity in a related list.

totalItems.description: Number of records matching this entry.

first.description: Search that returns the records matching this entry.

name.description: Name of the relationship. Present in related lists.

SearchResults.description: A page of results, as an ActivityStreams OrderedCollectionPage.

next.description: Next results page. Absent on the last page.

SearchEstimate.description: Estimated number of results for a search, as an ActivityStreams OrderedCollection. It contains no results; `first` and `last` link to the first and last pages of results.

label.description: Display name of the search scope.

AdvancedSearchState.description: A search query in the LUX JSON search grammar (`IAdvancedSearchState` in the frontend). `_scope` is the scope to search; the other keys are search terms or operators such as `AND`, `OR` and `NOT`, whose values are an array of objects, a string, a number, or an object.

_scope.description: Scope the query searches. The frontend uses it to choose the results tab and removes it before sending the rest as the `q` parameter of a search.
